name: pulsar/ai-governance
description: AI governance for the EU AI Act and ISO 42001:2023: a durable Article 50 register of transparency declarations and synthetic-content marking, provider and deployer roles that decide which obligations a deployment bears, Article 14 human oversight with a register of the overrides actually exercised, a model registry that refuses an Article 5 prohibited practice into production, impact assessments, audit logging, data governance, and explainability
